text:
mara: Heads up — us-west2 GPU pool saturation steady for ~12m. Queue length ~420, admission control firing, tail latencies creeping above 3s. Sales is asking for a temporary uplift for a paid PoC demo (Vellum) scheduled tomorrow morning. @sara any priority guidance?
devops-bot: ALERT: cluster=us-west2-gpu pool_util=0.98 qlen=420 admission=enabled kv_cache_pressure=0.73
jiang: Can we route that customer's traffic to dedicated capacity or another region? Do we have spare dedicated nodes?
mara: No spare dedicated nodes (reserved for enterprise tenants). Options: 1) scoped limit override for that token, 2) route to cpu-quant fallback (lower quality), 3) burst to spot GPUs in west2-a with isolated queue. Each has tradeoffs.
sara: Sales: Vellum demo is high priority (paid PoC). They need ~500 qps for a 2-hour window starting 10:00 PST. We need minimal quality degradation. Can we do a scoped override for 2 hours and bill them?
alex-sales: We can absorb incremental cost for the 2-hour window. SLA for the demo is required. Prefer not to use CPU fallback if it impacts quality noticeably.
jiang: Quick config note: current admission policy: max_active_requests_per_customer=50, global_queue_cap=500. If we bump a single customer to 150 we risk head-of-line blocking and degrading others.
mara: Also seeing KV cache shard pressure — adding more hot customers to same shard amplifies tail p99. My proposal: create an isolated "burst-vellum" queue with a burst_capacity and preempt_policy=drop-low-priority; route only their tokens. Scoped override reduces global interference.
devops-bot: PLAN: create queue=burst-vellum -> route token=tok-vellum -> burst_capacity=600 preempt_policy=drop-low-priority. Requires infra ops approval and finance signoff for cost.
tony: I can approve a 2-hour scoped override provided finance signs off and sales attaches a chargeback code. Need runbook + rollback plan before we flip.
finance-bot: COST_ESTIMATE: spot GPUs + transient egress ~ $5,200 for 2 hours. Confirm charge to cost center RWD-SALES-POC?
sara: Confirmed. Charge to RWD-SALES-POC. Please add runbook and a short rollback checklist.
mara: I'll author the runbook snippet and a lightweight dashboard. Rollback plan: remove route, drain burst queue, re-enable admission control. ETA ~18m to prepare and test.
jiang: Can we also apply a temporary soft throttle on non-priority customers (soft_throttle=0.8) to reduce interference while burst is active?
mara: Yes — we can patch global soft throttle for non-priority tiers. I'll stage in canary, then prod. Pushing changes now: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: burst-vellum-queue
data:
  burst_capacity: "600"
  preempt_policy: "drop-low-priority"
EOF
```
devops-bot: Deploy initiated by mara. CI checks passing.
devops-bot: Deploy complete. queue=burst-vellum active, routing rules applied, preemption enabled.
alex-sales: :thumbsup: Please ping when live so we can coordinate the customer kickoff.
mara: Live now. Observability: https://console.redwood/internal/queues/burst-vellum. Watch 99th pct latency and default pool queue length.
jiang: Early metrics: default-pool qlen down ~30%, burst-vellum qlen=410, p99 for Vellum ~2.1s. No visible impact on other high-priority tenants so far.
sara: Customer reports initial checks ok. Demo proceeding. We'll monitor for the duration and report back.
mara: Noted. I'll keep the dashboard open and escalate on anomalies.
devops-bot: Cost tracking enabled for override: tag=RWD-SALES-POC.
finance-bot: Running cost watch; will update if spend deviates >10% from estimate.
alex-sales: Demo confirmed success. Customer happy. Please plan closing the override at 12:15 PST.
mara: Scheduling rollback at 12:20 PST. Will remove route and drain queue; will post final metrics.
devops-bot: Rollback executed by mara at 12:20 PST. Admission control re-enabled, burst-vellum queue removed, metrics archived.
mara: Final summary: 2h scoped override completed. Total cost ~$5.4k (extra egress). No customer-impact incidents. Runbook saved: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/burst-vellum. I'll file a short postmortem and add a template for future scoped overrides. Thanks team. :party:
